items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: You ran into the great Eubie Blake in the hall of this Hyatt Hotel. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, what is he 90?

ctx.x: Well, no, most of them didn't. In fact, I got a lot of criticism, friendly ridicule about it. I have a couple of friends, very good trumpet players, one of them says, 'I don't take my trumpet out of the case unless I get paid for it.' But that kind of attitude for me would have been very dangerous. I had to keep practicing all the time.
You just told me something concerning that, as you were on your way up here to my room. You ran into the great Eubie Blake in the hall of this Hyatt Hotel.
